availability_rule.arrival_wall_origin: arm_t0 = time.monotonic() sampled immediately before backend.open_session(); verified in text_partition_probe/run.py run_session (tee_handle stamps arrival_wall = monotonic() - arm_t0; pump stamps consumer event wall on same clock). Send-origin/open offset: streaming pump paces chunks realtime (target = t0 + bytes-sent/16000 after loop start); source sample s maps to send wall ~= session_open_s + (s - p0)/16000 on the arm clock.
availability_rule.confirmation_support: correct-transition control charges annotation-supported boundary + 100ms (1600-sample) confirmation support; actual model/event compute lag UNKNOWN (never zero)
availability_rule.deadline: text-ownership seal time = accepted-final arrival wall (final_wall) on the same measured session clock; identical provider/text/policy/frontier across arms
availability_rule.definition: availability = wall-mapped evidence frontier (send_wall(frontier_sample)) + unknown nonnegative model/event lag L >= 0
availability_rule.max_permissible_lag: deadline_wall - send_wall(frontier_sample); reported exactly per timed-text case/arm. Negative => too_late even at zero lag. Nonnegative => conditional receipt only (UNKNOWN lag, never causal PASS on lower bound).
availability_rule.unknown_semantics: UNKNOWN != too_late != absent != unsupported. Unmeasured lag fails acceptance; never invented pass.
